items.subject: [AINews] Jeff, Sanjay, Oriol, and Quoc depart DeepMind; Demis to Chair; Koray to SVP
items.reason: Major AI lab leadership shakeup. Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le depart Google DeepMind to co-found Discovery Loop (@DiscoLoopAI), a Public Benefit Corporation focused on automating machine research. Demis Hassabis moves to Chairman, Koray Kavukcuoglu promoted to SVP. Jeff Dean's announcement tweet got 15K+ likes and 3.2M impressions.

enrichment.primary_event: Discovery Loop founding — autoresearch startup as PBC
enrichment.deepmind_restructuring: Demis Hassabis → Chairman, Koray Kavukcuoglu → SVP
other_stories_mentioned: Meta Spark 1.2 and Muse Code — 5.6 Terra-level model with local event log for resumability
Prime Agent by Prime Intellect — self-improving RLM harness, claims 95.5% on ARC-AGI-3
